sources.title: CladeTeam/CENO-1B-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CENO-1B-base is the base pretraining checkpoint of the 1B CENO DNA foundation model — a causal language model over genomic sequence built on a Nemotron-H Mamba / Attention / Mixture-of-Experts hybrid backbone (no MSA inputs).

sources.title: A 1-Billion-Parameter Math Model Is Testing AI's Scale-to-Value Story
sources.snippet: - Italian lab Paradigma released Limite 1B Violetto, a 1B-parameter math model achieving 94.01% on AIME 2026, outperforming larger models. - Open-sourced under Apache 2.0, the model challenges AI's "scale equals value" narrative by demonstrating high accuracy with minimal compute. - The result highlights decoupling of model capability from parameter count, shifting value toward specialized ...

sources.title: Meta Launches $1B Fund Amid AI Data Center Pushback
sources.snippet: Meta launches a $1B community fund to ease opposition to AI data centers as concerns over local impacts and benefits grow.
